justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/Evaluator.java:185-203; the class is a small wrapper with one field and one repo-level dependency in matches() (`element.hasClass(className)`). Repository references to `Evaluator.Class` are limited to src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java:310-313, src/main/java/org/jsoup/nodes/Element.java:1313-1316, and src/test/java/org/jsoup/select/EvaluatorTest.java:89-92. This shows low fan-in and low fan-out, not hub-like modularization.
